top_signal.title: How to earn trust
top_signal.summary: I’m trying to start a service company to reduce cloud costs, Azure and AWS. I got experience doing this on my last 2 jobs over 14 years and would like help on how to earn the trust of the client. My offer idea is to charge a percentage of the savings. If my work brings no savings, there is no payment, so there is no risk for the client. But I need to analyze the infrastructure of the client and it demands trust from them. Any insights are helpful, thank you.       submitted by     /u/juniorh2o       [link]       [comments]
